title: Feature Promotion vs Downgrade Decisions
brief: For each partial engine (esp. hyperMILL export/sync), decide: promote to real support, downgrade to explicit unsupported, or keep as partial with contract label. Reflect in code, tests, and docs.

units.title: Decide hyperMILL export/sync: promote, downgrade, or label partial

Update code comments, statuses, and test assertions to match
